page.layout: One printed page. Full-width ornamental rule at top, then title block in large italic capitals and italic lines, then a contents list of entries with page numbers at the right, ending with the signature "Harfcheri" at right. No running head, no page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.head: SYLLABVS MATERIARVM in hac secunda disputatione Iesuitica, tractatarum.
main_text.l: Verisimile Jesuitas novam suam artè mentiendi ab hæretico Ario didicisse. 5
Filius Dei est verus & æternus Deus benedictus in secula. 8
Calvinus Arii, Blandratæ, Gentilis & Gribaldi blasphemias refutat. 10
Historia de Petro Caroli, homine levi & contentiofo. 13
Calvinus creationem mundi Christo proprie tribuit. 17 & seq.
Deo Patri per singularem appropriationem, creatio, Filio redemptio, Spiritui S. sanctificatio tribuitur. 24 & seq.
Filius Dei cum Patre est ejusdem simplicis, infinitæ & æternæ essentiæ. 29

page.notes: The printed numerals in the contents are partly worn; "5", "8", "13", "15" and "29" are read with some doubt. The faint marks at the lower left are show-through or stains and are not transcribed.
